title: E-Man #15 First Comics June 1984 Joe Staton Cover Nova Kane Nick Cuti
conditionDescription: Bright, clean covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
E-Man #15 (June 1984), First Comics - "Tronn... they got me..." Written by Nicola Cuti, art and cover by Joe Staton. Baxter paper, $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: GrimJack #1 ad (John Ostrander and Timothy Truman).

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
